content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detecting anomaly: canary group `canary-eu` p95 latency climbed to ~1.2s (baseline ~240ms). Automated rollback attempted and reported failure. Paging on-call.

deploy-bot: Automated rollback triggered -> rollout-id=rl-3421 status=FAILED (hook timeout). See logs: https://deploy.redwood.ai/rl-3421

oncall-anne: ack. i'm on it. pulling up dashboards.

sre-marc: seen. looks like traffic got pinned to canary by an unexpected gating change. metric spike correlates with `use-new-serving` flag bump.

platform-sam: confirming - flag `use-new-serving` was rolled to 20% earlier by a CI job that didn't respect staging guard. rolling flag back to 0 now: `ffctl rollback use-new-serving --to 0 --who=platform-sam`

platform-sam: done, flag reverted. waiting ~30s for connections to drain. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

product-maya: any 5xx/500 alerts? customer-facing errors?

sre-marc: error rate up ~0.3% in eu region, mostly timeouts on long-lived generation calls. correlates with high memory spikes in model-worker. tagging eng-harper.

eng-harper: looking into logs — model batch handler OOM on long sequences after the recent quantization tweak. not safe to re-roll to canary. recommend manual rollback to previous model variant (v1.9.3) and scale that pool while we fix quantization patch.

oncall-anne: agree. manual rollback plan (brief):
1) pin traffic for `canary-eu` to previous variant v1.9.3 at 100%
2) scale up the previous pool replicas to handle short surge
3) run smoke test and a small synthetic load check
4) verify p95 and error-rate back to baseline for 10min
5) hand off to follow-up owner and start postmortem

oncall-anne: executing now:
```
# pin traffic to previous variant
redwood route update --region eu --model canary-eu --variant v1.9.3 --percent 100
# scale previous pool
redwood capacity scale --pool eu-prod --model v1.9.3 --replicas 6
```

deploy-bot: Route update accepted. job=route-ctl-5599. Scaling started: job-7782.

platform-sam: scale complete, instances healthy (6/6). :white_check_mark:

sre-marc: running smoke curl and latency check:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total} %{http_code}\n"
```
response: 0.18 200 (180ms, 200 OK)

product-maya: pulling customer impact. early list: AcmeCorp (batch sync jobs), FinLedger (some rate-limited queries). CS notified and triage note created.

oncall-anne: dashboards: p95 back to ~230ms, error-rate to baseline. Manual rollback verified.

eng-harper: i'll cut a hotfix branch to revert the quant change and run it through internal staging canary. will defer re-roll until we confirm memory profile.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> RESOLVED (manual rollback complete). Severity downgraded to S2. Postmortem owner: eng-harper. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234

oncall-anne: handing monitoring to next on-call for warm watch: @sre-jordan 30m takeover.

sre-jordan: ack taking over. will ping if anything resurfaces.

oncall-anne: quick notes: we need an ops-checklist to prevent ffctl jobs from promoting to prod without staging lock. follow-up action item assigned. :memo:

product-maya: thanks team. i'll coordinate customer comms for impacted tenants and ensure CS does followups. :thumbsup:

eng-harper: will own postmortem and link regression tests for long-sequence inputs.

incident-bot: Reminder: please fill the incident template and attach the runbook steps used during the manual rollback.

sre-marc: brief timeline to attach to ticket:
- 2112345678 incident detected by anomaly (p95 spike)
- 2112345684 automated rollback attempted -> failed
- 2112345690 flag revert attempted -> completed
- 2112345708 manual rollback (route pin + scale) executed
- 2112345725 smoke tests passed; metrics normalized

oncall-anne: closing thread from on-call side, handing to postmortem owner. good catch on the flag pipeline.

sre-jordan: :eyes: monitoring ongoing.
